Kit summary

Frost Leap SlashBasicExclusive Lv.3
Deals DMG by 15% of Adkins's Max HP to a single enemy, with a 100% chance to inflict [Crit Rate Down Ⅱ] for 2 turns.
Forgotten Guard Lv.3Frost Leap Slash: After dealing DMG, also inflicts 1 layer of [Frozen Blood] on the target for 2 turns, up to 3 layers can be owned. When [Frozen Blood] on enemies is stacked to a certain number of layers, the skill will have extra effects: 1 layer: Each layer makes Frost Leap Slash deal extra DMG by 15% of Adkins's Max HP. 2 layers: Ignores [Shield], [Immortal], and [DMG Immunity] owned by the target. 3 layers: Removes all buffs owned by the target before dealing DMG.
Everfrost ShieldActive
Grants all allies a [Shield] by 60% of Adkins's Max HP for 2 turns.
Frigid OathPassiveExclusive Lv.1
Adkins is immune to Turn Meter Reduction effect. When any enemy gains [Heal] or at the end of each turn, if Adkins has 40% or less Turn Meter, she gains 8% Turn Meter; if not, Adkins pursues and attacks the enemy with the highest ATK, up to 4 times after each action taken by self.
Forgotten Guard Lv.1At the end of any enemy's turn, Adkins has a 100% chance to inflict [Cold II] on them for 2 turns. If the enemy already has [Cold], inflicts [Cold II] on all enemies instead. When any enemy gains [Heal], grants all allies of Adkins 4% Turn Meter.
Unbreakable IceActiveExclusive Lv.2
Grants all allies [Consolidation II] for 2 turns and [Tenacity Up II] for 2 turns. When casting Unbreakable Ice, if self has 200% or more Effect RES, [Consolidation II] granted will be upgraded to [Ice Consolidation] which cannot be removed. [Ice Consolidation]: Reduces Direct DMG taken by 40%. Cannot be removed.
Forgotten Guard Lv.2Increases Adkins's Crit DMG by 55% of her initial Effect RES, up to 110% Crit DMG can be increased this way. Increases Crit Rate by 20% of her initial Effect RES, up to 40% Crit Rate can be increased this way. Reduces Basic Attack DMG and Skill DMG taken by allies with [Ice Consolidation] by 30%.
